{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for -1 values in customer_age
age_sentinel_count = (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_sentinel_count}")

# Check revenue column for thousands separators
print("\nFirst 5 values of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check for channel imbalance
channel_segment_cross = pd.crosstab(data['channel'], data['customer_segment'])
print("\nChannel by customer_segment cross-tab:")
print(channel_segment_cross)"}
